item.title: Fixing discord.py Message Content Issues with Intents
item.description:
“Fixing discord.py Message Content Issues with Intents”

When developing a bot using the discord.py library, developers often encounter scenarios where the bot fails to process or read the content of messages sent in channels. This typically arises from changes in the Discord API concerning message privacy and data access. The core resolution involves correctly enabling and utilizing Intents, specifically the Message Content Intent.

How do you configure a discord.py bot to properly access message content following recent Discord API updates?
